summary: Local Cowork needs a native plugin MCP companion with its sibling CLI and a session-first skill, not a host binary invoked from its Linux shell.
reason: Terminal plugin discovery does not cross Cowork's execution boundary. A separately packaged native stdio connection reuses the same OS user's saved login without exporting credentials, changing Claude Code settings, or exposing a remote service; cloud Cowork remains unsupported.
validated_outcome: Synthetic archive tests exercise integrity, safe contents and deterministic native platform packages. Native macOS MCP tests prove startup/discovery makes no API requests, sibling resolution works without PATH, read-only fixture inspection succeeds and expired sessions fail. An isolated Claude loader advertises the skill and MCP tools. Actual Cowork UI and live-account acceptance remain user-owned.
